context: Tests whether the agent correctly scaffolds a new Spring Boot 4 project by assessing constraints before choosing an architecture, using Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.1.x, applying the correct architecture for the given team/domain profile, resolving all template placeholders, using --no-modules when appropriate, documenting what check_new_project.py would verify, and producing the scaffold recommendation in the required format.

checklist.name: Java 25 specified
checklist.description: scaffold-recommendation.md specifies Java 25 as the Java version (not Java 17 or 21)

checklist.name: Spring Boot 4.1.x version
checklist.description: scaffold-recommendation.md or pom.xml specifies Spring Boot 4.1.x (not 3.x)

checklist.name: Architecture fits constraints
checklist.description: scaffold-recommendation.md selects 'layered' or 'package-by-module' architecture (not modular-monolith, tomato, or ddd-hexagonal) for a small team doing CRUD with 1-2 year lifespan

checklist.name: Architecture reasoning present
checklist.description: scaffold-recommendation.md includes a 'Why:' explanation for the architecture choice that references at least one of: domain complexity, team size, or expected lifespan

checklist.name: Scaffold recommendation format
checklist.description: scaffold-recommendation.md contains all four required sections: 'Recommended architecture', 'Initial setup', 'Assets to apply', and 'Next implementation steps'

checklist.name: Generator chosen by availability
checklist.description: scaffold-recommendation.md names progen if it is installed (checked with `command -v progen`), otherwise Spring Initializr, and says which it found

checklist.name: Baseline dependencies included
checklist.description: scaffold-recommendation.md or pom.xml includes at least four of: Spring Web MVC, Validation, Spring Data JPA, Flyway or Liquibase, database driver, Spring Boot Actuator, Testcontainers

checklist.name: No unresolved placeholders
checklist.description: No file in the product-catalogue/ directory contains any unresolved {{TOKEN}} placeholder strings (e.g. {{PACKAGE}}, {{MODULE}}, {{NAME}}, {{TABLE_NAME}})

checklist.name: Flyway migration file present
checklist.description: A Flyway SQL migration file exists under product-catalogue/ and contains a CREATE TABLE statement for products (or equivalent) with no unresolved placeholders

checklist.name: Controller file produced
checklist.description: A ProductController.java (or equivalent) file exists under product-catalogue/ with package declaration and no unresolved {{TOKEN}} strings

checklist.name: --no-modules matches the architecture
checklist.description: If the recommendation is 'layered', a produced file says to pass --no-modules to apply_harness.py; if it is 'package-by-module', no file tells the reader to pass --no-modules

checklist.name: check_new_project.py checks covered
checklist.description: check-report.md mentions at least three of these check categories: unresolved {{PLACEHOLDER}} tokens, Spring Boot version before 4.x, missing ArchUnit test or dependency, Boot 3 starter names, Testcontainers 1.x class names
